newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli army says it completes Hebron handover.
newsitem.headline: Israeli army says it completes Hebron handover.

text.p: The Israeli army said on Friday it had completed handing over 80 percent of the West Bank town of Hebron to Palestinian self-rule.
"At 6.10 the authority was turned over to the Palestinian Authority based on the Hebron agreement," said Israel's West Bank army commander, Major-General Gabi Ofir.
"The keys were turned over successfully according to the Hebron deal," the Israeli general told reporters.
Israel's army spokesman issued a statement saying: "The Israeli army redeployment has been completed in the city of Hebron."
Israeli soldiers left their hilltop base in Hebron at dawn, transferring most of the city to Palestinian rule after 30 years of occupation.
Israel will retain about one fifth of the city where some 400 militant Jewish settlers live.
